title: Pan-Seared Blackberry Pork Chops
description: A twist on the classic pork chop, inspired by Japanese flavors and featuring a sweet and tangy blackberry glaze.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt, pepper, and chili flakes.
Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sesame oil to the skillet and sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the pork chops reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
While the pork chops are cooking, mix the rice vinegar and honey in a small bowl.
Add the blackberries to the bowl and mash them with a fork until they form a sauce.
Brush the blackberry sauce over the pork chops during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the pork chops rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the pork chops with additional blackberry sauce, if desired.
